cd /opt/trading-bot/classic && sudo -u tbot /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python - <<EOF
import json, urllib.request, sys, warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
sys.path.insert(0, ".")
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, classic_analysis as an, classic_trendline as tl
out = {}
for sym, tf in (("ZECUSDT","4h"),("ZECUSDT","1h"),("NEARUSDT","4h"),("BTCUSDT","1h")):
    d = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("https://api.binance.com/api/v3/klines?symbol=%s&interval=%s&limit=1000" % (sym, tf), timeout=20))
    df = pd.DataFrame(d).iloc[:, [0,1,2,3,4,5,6]]; df.columns = ["t","o","h","l","c","v","ct"]
    for k in "ohlcv": df[k] = df[k].astype(float)
    closed = df.iloc[:-1].reset_index(drop=True); ind = an.indicators(closed)
    K = 140; st = len(closed) - K
    info = tl.chart_info(closed.o.values, closed.h.values, closed.l.values, closed.c.values, ind["atr"].values, None, len(closed), shift=st)
    out[sym + tf] = dict(o=[round(x, 4) for x in closed.o.values[st:]], h=[round(x, 4) for x in closed.h.values[st:]], l=[round(x, 4) for x in closed.l.values[st:]], c=[round(x, 4) for x in closed.c.values[st:]], tl=info)
print(json.dumps(out))
EOF
